item.title: A recording of CEO Marc Benioff's keynote was posted on Salesforce's internal site. His jokes about ICE weren't included.
item.description: Salesforce CEO Marc Benioff faces backlash for ICE jokes during a keynote. Employees criticized how the recording did not include those comments.

item.title: Instagram's top exec grilled about his pay at social media addiction trial
item.description: Adam Mosseri said he can make "tens of millions" a year in court, as prosecutors pressed the Meta exec about its policies affecting social media users.

item.title: A GoFundMe was set up for James Van Der Beek's family — 'the extended fight against cancer have left the family out of funds'
item.description: A GoFundMe shared by James Van Der Beek's wife is raising funds to cover bills following the actor's death from colorectal cancer at 48.

item.title: 3 takeaways from Elon Musk's xAI all-hands, from a moon city to a company restructuring
item.description: Musk addressed the company for the first time since its merger with SpaceX and shared the plans for the company's restructuring.

item.title: Russia has started an 'evacuation' of its citizens from Cuba amid the island's jet fuel crisis
item.description: Russian authorities said two major airlines were flying one-way flights out of Cuba, as the Trump administration pressures the island's oil supply.

item.title: Anthropic says it will pay 100% of the grid upgrade costs tied to its AI data centers
item.description: Anthropic pledged to cover all grid upgrade costs for its AI data centers, saying households shouldn't foot the bill.

item.title: Congress defies Trump on tariffs amid his ongoing spat with Canada
item.description: A bipartisan coalition in the House delivered a rare rebuke of Trump's tariffs by voting against his duties on Canada, citing economic concerns.

item.title: DeepMind's CEO does a 'second day' of work at night: 'I come alive at about 1 a.m.'
item.description: Hassabis said that he tries to pack his day in the office with as many meetings as possible with "almost no time" in between them.

item.title: Olympic skier Tess Johnson, 25, says one simple daily habit powers her performance — and it doesn't involve the gym
item.description: US mogul skier Tess Johnson credits her daily habit as "just a way to stay present and get off my phone from time to time."

item.title: McDonald's execs are figuring out how to handle more customers on GLP-1s
item.description: GLP-1 drug users are known to have suppressed appetites and a preference for protein-rich foods.
